Top Navigation.rule: A semantic action keeps the same slot across screens; unused slots remain empty.

Bottom Toolbar.rule: Related actions and selected-state pills remain centered on their family slot; absent actions leave a blank slot.
Bottom Toolbar.implementationNote: Visible glyph size is intentionally smaller than the interaction target. Production must preserve at least a 44 pt hit area without enlarging the artwork.

sequence: Intro skeleton exits; intro text fades and rises 8 pt
Quote part 1 skeleton exits; text fades and rises 8 pt
Quote part 2 skeleton exits; text fades and rises 8 pt
Closing skeleton exits; text fades and rises 8 pt
Reader Translation Motion.rule: Skeleton and translated text crossfade by paragraph so the article geometry remains stable; no global spinner or full-screen replacement.

Reader Scrolled Header.statusBarSurface: Fully opaque BabelPalette.background at alpha 1 from the physical top edge through safeAreaInsets.top. No Liquid Glass, blur, translucency, scroll-edge effect, or article underlap in any Reader state.
Reader Scrolled Header.rule: After the large title and byline leave the viewport, pin a compact header below the status area. Circular-clip the runtime feed icon and draw one uninterrupted clockwise progress arc from 12 o'clock for every continuous p in [0,1]. Samples are QA checkpoints, not discrete runtime modes. After pinning, 12 pt of upward travel reveals the top controls and bottom toolbar together; 12 pt of downward travel hides both over 180 ms linearly. Ignore small reversals and boundary overscroll. Keep the compact identity fixed and preserve the reader route and scroll position.

Feed Filter Interaction.rule: Starred, Unread, and All are mutually exclusive in-place Change To states with fixed slots and 44 pt hit areas. Selecting a filter replaces the current collection and resets the list to top without push navigation, a card, menu, modal, or sheet.

Feed Source Hero.statusBarSurface: Fully opaque BabelPalette.background at alpha 1. The source image begins below screen y = 59 and never underlaps status items.
Feed Source Hero.rule: Migrate the existing TimelineFeedHeader implementation; do not create a second resolver or fallback system from Figma. Preserve FeedHeroIconLoader -> FeedIconDownloader -> FaviconDownloader, caching, suitability analysis, low-resolution softening, dominant-color fallback, paper wash, vertical fade, and scroll interpolation. The New York Times image in Figma is only a visual specimen of enlarge + aspectFill crop + moderate dimming while keeping the source identifiable. While the title overlaps artwork, keep title glyphs effect-free and render the two-layer Hero Title Readability Feather behind the full title area; its luminance change must decay continuously to transparent with no detectable component boundary. Move and fade it with the title, then remove it in the compact paper-only state. Keep navigation slots, filter state, article-row instances, and bottom toolbar stable.

Translation Model Catalog.rule: Push the dedicated editor. Refresh is first, followed by a dynamic popularity Top 10 and vendor sections with repository logos and exactly three representative models each. Selection remains pending until the navigation checkmark saves it.
